description: Show an open drawing in an interactive image viewer with pan, zoom, a layer list to switch layers on and off, and model/layout/block/named-view switching. onlyLayers, hideLayers and onlyHandles open it already showing only part of the drawing. Falls back to a PNG in clients without MCP Apps.

onlyLayers.description: Show only these layers (names, any case).

name: cad.show_document
